description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) for Verifiable Credential (VC) operations, including verification of VCs and DID resolution, integrated with the Cobra CLI library. It processes VC files in different formats, performs DID resolution via web or custom endpoints, and outputs verification results in JSON or pretty formats.

methods.name: NewVCCommand
methods.description: Creates the main 'vc' command with subcommands for VC operations.

methods.name: NewVCVerifyCommand
methods.description: Creates the 'verify' subcommand for verifying a VC file.

methods.name: verifyVC
methods.description: Performs the verification process on a specified VC file, including parsing, DID resolution, and comprehensive verification.

methods.name: collectUniqueDIDs
methods.description: Extracts all unique DIDs from the VC chain for resolution.

methods.name: resolveDID
methods.description: Resolves a DID using various strategies: web, custom endpoint, or bundled info.

methods.name: resolveWebDID
methods.description: Resolves a did:web DID by fetching from well-known URLs.

methods.name: resolveFromWeb
methods.description: Resolves a DID via web or did:key methods.

methods.name: resolveFromCustom
methods.description: Resolves a DID via a custom resolver endpoint.

methods.name: resolveKeyDID
methods.description: Resolves a did:key DID (not fully implemented).

methods.name: extractPublicKeyFromDIDDoc
methods.description: Extracts the public key in JWK format from a DID document.

methods.name: verifyVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies a VC's cryptographic signature (placeholder for future implementation).

methods.name: verifyWorkflowVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies a workflow VC's signature (placeholder for future implementation).

methods.name: getDIDMethod
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a DID identifier.

methods.name: convertLegacyChain
methods.description: Converts legacy VC chain data to the enhanced format.

methods.name: normalizeEnhancedChain
methods.description: Normalizes the enhanced VC chain, keeping execution and component VCs in sync and setting defaults.

methods.name: outputResult
methods.description: Outputs the verification result in specified format (JSON or pretty).

methods.name: outputJSON
methods.description: Outputs the result as JSON and exits with code 1 if invalid.

methods.name: outputPretty
methods.description: Outputs the result in a human-readable formatted manner, including verification steps and DID resolutions.
